report.title: Investment report of the bridge project

parts.text: The total investment of the bridge project is 120 billion dong, financed by the state budget, and the contractor is Lead Builders.
The contractor completed the foundation works two weeks late because of the rain in the second quarter.
Acceptance of the main span is planned for March 2027 after the load test.
The contractor must submit a corrected schedule before the second payment.
